(1) apprenticeships provide an opportunity structure for youth to enter the labour market and gain access to skilled work; (2) the opportunity structure provided by apprenticeships is shaped by the local labour market, which in turn affects youth’s educational and occupational trajectories; (3) apprenticeships can also be exploitative, and tighter regulation is needed to protect apprentices.
apprenticeship programmes can be an effective way to prepare young people for work, but that there are significant challenges in ensuring that they are not exploited in the workplace.

apprenticeships can be effective for some youth, but that there are significant differences between provinces that are likely to affect the success of these programmes.
